subject.title: fix(cli): reject --channel/--to for systemEvent cron jobs with a clear error

question: Should `cron add` intentionally turn previously accepted-but-discarded `--channel` and `--to` arguments on main-session system-event jobs into an immediate CLI error?
rationale: The patch is technically correct and prevents misleading job creation, but it deliberately changes the outcome of existing command lines and therefore needs ownership of the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept fail-fast validation
options.body: Land the guard so unsupported explicit chat-delivery arguments fail clearly instead of creating a job that cannot deliver as requested.

options.title: Use a warning transition
options.body: Temporarily preserve command acceptance while warning that the arguments are ignored, then reject them after a documented transition.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-fast validation
recommendation.body: Land the guard so unsupported explicit chat-delivery arguments fail clearly instead of creating a job that cannot deliver as requested.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent history most directly connects this person to cron creation validation and delivery-routing compatibility.
